units: <cite ref="Niddah 14a:28">Nidd. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>שמש רְצָפָהּ</he> the membrum may have crushed it.—Part. pass. <he>רָצוּף</he>; f. <he>רְצוּפָה</he>; pl. <he>רְצוּפִים</he>, <he>רְצוּפִין</he>; <he>רְצוּפוֹת</he>.

senses.gloss: (cmp. כָּתַת a. denom.) to join closely, to place in rows; to pave with blocks. Ohol. XVIII, 5 הרוֹצֵף … באבנים if one paves an unclean field (v. פְּרָס) with stones.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 1:1:4">Y. Orl. I, beg. 60ᶜ</cite> <he>במשנה … לעצים ברוצף</he> when he changes the usual order of planting; if he wants to use them for fuel, he plants the trees close together, &c., opp. <he>משפה</he> planting wide apart.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 3:4:4">Y. Kil. III, 28ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>רוצף</he> he who plants vegetables in a row, opp. <he>עושה קלחים יחידים</he>; a. e.—Part. pass. as ab.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:7">Esth. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>היה ביתו ר׳ וכ׳</he> his house was paved with precious stones and jewels.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 11:9">Neg. XI, 9</cite> <he>השתי אם היה ר׳</he> if the warp (on the loom) is close (the threads being properly arranged).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 29a:9">B. Bath. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>שלש … שאכלן ר׳</he> by the three years of which they speak is meant that he had the undisturbed usufruct for three years in succession, opp. <he>מפוזרות</he>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 37b:5">Ib. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>אכלן ר׳</he> if he has had the usufruct of trees planted close together in rows (which shows that they were intended to be transplanted when grown older).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 37b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מכרן ר׳ וכ׳</he> if he sold closely planted trees, the buyer cannot claim the soil.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:4:5">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᶜ</cite> top, a. e. <he>ר׳</he>, opp. <he>מרווחין</he>, v. <cite ref="T00326"><he>רָוַוח</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 8:10:4">Y. Gitt. VIII, end, 49ᵈ</cite> <he>בר׳</he> when the signatures are close together, opp. <he>מסורגין</he>, v. <cite ref="O01526"><he>סָרַג</he></cite>.
Treat. Sof’rim I, 10, v. סָרַג; a. fr.—Trnsf. crowded, stuffed.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:2">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32">Gen. R. s. 32</cite>; a. fr., v. <cite ref="T00706"><he>רֵיקָן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Beitzah 28b:5">Bets. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>שפוד שנ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>שנרצם</he>, corr. acc.) a roasting spit which has been squeezed and bent, contrad. to <cite ref="T00990"><he>נרצם</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Moed Kattan 1:2">Tosef. M. Kat. I, 2</cite> <he>מרצפין</he> ed. Zuck., read: <he>מרבצין</he> or <he>מרביצין</he>, v. <cite ref="T00137"><he>רָבַץ</he></cite>.]
